dedupe_keys.name: hourly resolved truck flows and rest stops on the german road network

description: This dataset provides hourly truck traffic flows and spatio-temporal data on truck breaks and rest stops on the German road network. It was made by disaggregating yearly road freight flows between European NUTS-3 regions both spatially, from 401 NUTS-3 regions to 4,620 municipality associations in Germany, and in time, from yearly to hourly flows. The deposit, by Edgar Jungblut of Forschungszentrum Jülich, holds a 1.5 GB CSV of 2030 freight utilisation by road link, a European road node table, a data inventory and the Jupyter notebooks for freight demand, road network preparation, routing and utilisation analysis, with a conda environment file. Coverage is Germany, with European origin-destination flows as input, for the 2030 scenario year. Access: free download from Zenodo (version 1.1.0, May 2026); the data are under the ODbL and the code under the MIT licence. Caveats: the flows are modelled, not counted, and the main file is large. The authors state that the resolution allows planning and sizing of road capacity and of rest, charging and fuelling stops. It supports network flow and capacity studies of the German motorway network and electric truck charging planning, and complements the synthetic European road freight flows and the truck parking locations catalogued here.
